thread:
Mae: Heads up — planning to onboard SlateX v2 into the catalog tomorrow 09:30 PST. Need owners for smoke+rollback readiness. Can folks ack?
Samir: I can own the canary smoke. Will run generation/embeddings sanity and perf checks. :thumbsup:
Leo: I can do the pin in the catalog and validate alias routing after smoke.
Anya: Would like to run my eval suite against the v2 prompts (latency + quality). ETA ~10:30 PST.
Ryan: devops-bot scheduled a maintenance window overlap? I can cover infra monitoring and change rollback hooks.
devops-bot: Scheduled deploy window: 2026-03-18 09:30-10:30 PST. Canary rollout at 5% -> 25% -> 100% if metrics OK. Auto-rollback on >3% error spike or 40% p95 latency increase.
Olivia: Quick ask — are we pinning to v2.1 or v2.0? Need exact model id for downstream feature flags.
Mae: Pin to slatex-v2.1 (quantized-8). Leo to apply model pin and alias swap after first green canary.
Samir: Smoke checklist I plan to run:
- basic generation (3 prompts)
- embeddings consistency (10 queries)
- tokenization spot check
- stress concurrent 50 qps for 5m
If anything odd I'll post logs here.
Anya: I'll run the eval harness — will post score diffs. If quality reg drops >2 points we'll hold rollout.
Leo: Pin change snippet I'll apply in the catalog UI and via CLI if needed. Quick config I pasted here:
```
model_id: "slatex-v2.1-quant8"
alias: "slatex-stable"
pin: true
canary_percentage: 5
```
Ryan: Monitoring hooks: I'll enable a temporary sanity alert rule: p95 latency > 350ms or errors > 1% => paging and immediate rollback toggle ready.
Olivia: Any known compatibility changes (tokenizer or max seq)? Need to update client defaults.
Samir: Max seq same. Tokenizer: small tokenizer merges — shouldn't affect existing prompts but callouts for edge cases in eval.
MAE: small typo — my name is Mae (all lower ok). Will be on standby during canary.
devops-bot: Reminder: please add the deploy runbook link in thread before start. See: https://internal.redwood/deploys/slatex-v2.1
qa-bot: QA will run smoke tests at 09:35 PST and post pass/fail. If fail, please include reproducer and logs.
Leo: Added pin + runbook link. Will not swap alias until Samir confirms smoke.
Samir: Starting first smoke at 09:35 PST. Will post results by 09:45.
Anya: Eval queued now — expected results by 10:05.
Ryan: Infra watch on. If auto-rollback triggers I'll confirm and follow with manual rollback if needed.
Mae: Thanks all. If we get green across smoke + eval + infra, plan to ramp to 25% at 09:55 and full by 10:15. Post any blockers here.
Olivia: ACK — I'll update client feature-flag docs after alias swap.
Samir: Smoke PASS — minor token merge oddity in 1 prompt, not blocking. Posting details + logs.
Anya: Eval shows +0.6 quality; latency +20ms p95. Within thresholds, good to proceed.
Leo: Alias swapped to slatex-stable at 25% now.
Ryan: Ramp monitoring healthy. No error spikes. Proceeding to 100% per schedule.
Samir: Final smoke at 100% PASS. Rolling up notes to the catalog changelog.
Mae: Excellent — closing the rollout. Thanks everyone :tada:
